summary: Kimi Antonelli inherited victory at Barcelona after a virtual safety car bunched the field in the closing laps, undoing Lando Norris's dominant run from pole position. Norris described himself as "insanely unlucky" as the timing of the safety car negated his advantage and allowed the Mercedes driver to capitalize on the restart. The result narrows McLaren's championship lead as Antonelli's breakthrough win elevates Mercedes back into contention.
